title: tillandsia capillaris f. hieronymi
intro: Tillandsia capillaris f. hieronymi, commonly known as the "Bristle Airplant", is a type of epiphyte that belongs to the bromeliad family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Tillandsia capillaris f. hieronymi are attributed to its ability to relax the airways and alleviate symptoms of asthma and bronchitis, while also acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites found in its leaves.
